Barclays Life Assurance Kenya renamed Absa Life Assurance Kenya
Printed as Geminia Life Insurance Company from Q3 2020 (previously Geminia Insurance Company)
Takaful life business last printed Q2 2020
UAP Life acquires OMLAC; OMLAC becomes a closed fund and new business is written in UAP Life (both keep reporting separately)
ICEA Life Assurance renamed ICEA LION Life Assurance
Equity Life Assurance (Kenya) licensed by IRA
Saham Assurance life book: premium nil from Q3 2021, last printed Q1 2022
UAP Life Assurance renamed Old Mutual Life Assurance Kenya (OMLAK). IRA prints the new name from Q2 2022

Star Discover Life Insurance first printed Q3 2023
Printed as Jubilee Life Insurance from Q1 2025 (previously Jubilee Insurance Company)
Tamini Insurance (Djibouti) acquires a majority stake in Takaful Insurance of Africa
OMLAC long-term business transferred to OMLAK. IRA prints OMLAC for the last time at Q3 2025 and OMLAK year-to-date premium jumps in Q4 2025
Sanlam Life Insurance renamed Sanlam Allianz Life Insurance (Kenya); parent plans to take the life business into the listed company
Absa sells its stake to First Assurance Investments; Absa Life Assurance Kenya to be renamed First Assurance Life
